last_assistant_message:
Task complete: both files rewritten in place. Done, reporting.

**`@Overview.md` changes:**
- Purpose section now frames the exit bar as DLP v2 Completion using the same artifact formats and vocabulary candidates will deliver with.
- Candidate profile: tool list updated to Claude Code / Devin / GitHub Copilot (Windsurf dropped); "commands" references removed in favor of skill invocation.
- Pass criteria rewritten: Prompt/Harness/Model + RTCC, EC-first manual test files, directing AI-written Python evaluation scripts (no Python prerequisite), EDD load-bearing discipline, skills with `disable-model-invocation: true` plus invocation graduation and adversarial agents, bounded agent runs, behavior change.
- New "Foundational Concepts" section with three subsections: Prompt/Harness/Model (with "a model without a harness is a chat interface"), EDD (Red/Green/Refactor reworded for skills, EC framing, deterministic-first/LLM-judge-second with the regex line), and the v2 Automation Spectrum including IIOS Stage 3/4 framing and the "slop cannon" warning.
- Structure table: Week 2 now references DLP skeleton skills + YAML pipeline contracts; Week 3 retitled "Model Invocation, Adversarial Agents, and Bounded Agents".
- Certification gate checklist fully rebuilt to mirror the DLP EE-Implementation-Guide requirements (Python eval script with baseline + 3+ iterations, adversarial agent with documented findings, invocation graduation or gap spec, bounded agent run, demonstrated evaluation ability, Craft/Evaluate/Iterate/Adopt self-assessment). All Promptfoo and sentinel/hook artifacts removed.
- Added stretch-practice note wiring in the orphaned `Resources/Katas/`, and a derived-artifact note for `PDFs/`.

**`Week-1.md` changes:**
- Social media theme, 4-stage pipeline, EDD-first spine, and day/half-day timing all preserved.
- Monday restructured: EDD block (1:00–2:15, EC vocabulary), new Prompt/Harness/Model block (2:15–3:00, explains why `disable-model-invocation: true` is a harness-level decision), RTCC block (3:00–4:15, updated to WHO/WHAT/WHY/HOW with the "right RTCC section" audit diagnostic), reflection (4:15–5:00).
- All four pipeline artifacts are now `.skill.md` files with frontmatter; a "skill file anatomy" example added at Tuesday's first build.
- Tuesday 3:30–5:00 "Introduction to Promptfoo" replaced with "AI-Written Python Evaluation Scripts": AI writes the code, candidate directs and reviews; deterministic-first/LLM-judge-second; JSON structured judgments; exercise produces 2 deterministic + 1 judge check and a recorded Red baseline; the regex/EC-refinement rule included as a blockquote.
- Wednesday–Friday: every Promptfoo reference swapped to the Python eval workflow (same Red/Green/Refactor, one change per iteration, load-bearing audit made mechanical via the script). "Commands" language retired except for slash-command invocation.
- Coaching notes: Promptfoo-specific bullets replaced with v2 failure modes (AI writing the EC instead of just the script, everything-as-LLM-judge, permissive judge rubrics, unread generated scripts tied to the over-truster failure mode).
- Objectives, artifacts review, and deliverables checklists updated to match; katas wired in as optional stretch practice.

**Judgment calls:**
1. Kept em-dashes in structural elements only (page titles, time-block headers like "### 1:00 – 2:15 PM — EDD...", and the "R — Role" bullets) to match the established style of Week-2/3/4 and the DLP source files; all body prose is em-dash-free per canon.
2. Compressed RTCC to 75 min (not the full original 90) to fit the Prompt/Harness/Model block without moving the 5:00 PM end.
3. Added a "read the script, be able to explain each check" requirement in Tuesday's exercise, since the cert gate now requires demonstrating rather than explaining Python evaluation.

**Out-of-scope note:** Week-2/3/4 still contain Promptfoo, hooks/sentinels, and old RTCC definitions; the parent's other forks are handling those.
